messages:
miriam: quick flag — noticed ruby sampleapp keeps growing when using streaming responses + refreshable tokens. repro locally after ~30 requests.
jamal: hmm — steps to repro? ruby version / gemfile?
miriam: ruby 3.1.2, bundle from main, using refreshable token flow (short-lived creds). very small app: open stream, read chunks, call refresh, continue. memory climbs steadily.
alex: can you paste a minimal snippet?
miriam: sure:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(token: refreshable_token)
client.chat.stream do |chunk|
  buffer << chunk.text
  # simulate token refresh in separate thread
end
```
jamal: I think the stream keeps references to the buffer until the entire request object is GC'd. when token refresh swaps the underlying HTTP connection we might be retaining old response bodies.
lee: devex-bot just reported CI matrix: macos-arm64 runner failing on an unrelated flaky spec in the sampleapp. might be hiding this.
devex-bot: CI failed: sampleapp_spec.rb (macos-arm64). See CI link: https://ci/internal/78543 
alex: proposal: after stream ends explicitly clear the per-request buffers (e.g., buffer.clear; buffer = nil) and add a small GC hint in the client teardown. not ideal but lowers peak. add test that runs 50 short streams and checks RSS.
jamal: agree for mitigation. we should also add an integration test on CI that runs a simple loop of 100 streams to catch regressions (can be opt-in on slower runners).
miriam: opened draft PR in #412 with the explicit niling and a param to enable the stress test in CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/412 (draft).
lee: quick review — nit: use buffer.clear while preserving object identity for callers who hold reference. setting to nil might surprise. maybe do both: buffer.clear; buffer.replace("") then GC.start if ENV['CI_STRESS'].
alex: good call. also add a comment linking to this thread so future folks understand the GC behavior.
jamal: ran local stress harness from PR — memory growth reduced significantly. macos-arm64 runner still flaky; opening infra ticket to move stress test to linux-only for now.
miriam: thanks — I'll update PR to use buffer.replace("") and add the CI gate.
lee: LGTM after small changes. please squash and target beta branch.
devex-bot: PR #412 status: CI passed (linux), macos-arm64 skipped-stress.
miriam: merged and backported to beta. leaving a post-merge note in changelog. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
jamal: nice catch. labeling as maintenance/backport-needed.
alex: follow-up issue to investigate persistent references in HTTP client — created #428.
miriam: closing thread — will monitor telemetry next week.
